_doc: Macro hypotheses as weighted scorer terms (plan item 3), read by runmodel.BasePolicy (the rollout policy behind price and the scripted baseline) and tools/baseline.py PriceMacro. Each term: value(s), tag, the skill rule it implements. Worth units: runmodel.worth per reference fight (loss -1, win 1 + 0.5 x end HP fraction). Set a weight to 0 to ablate.
